title: Codex Engram bootstrap has no capability gate or degrade path for config/read
outcome:
Both structured reviewers examined the Codex Engram new-thread bootstrap in the
implementation checkout (HEAD 0e7ab55, tracked diff 642ffdc4...). Claude review
session-6531 raised this as Medium at src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs:78 and
proposed P1; the parent agrees with P1 because the failure is TOTAL and
PERMANENT for an affected user, not degraded.

The bootstrap hard-depends on a Codex app-server `config/read` RPC that appears
nowhere else in this repository. There is NO capability gate and NO degrade
path. Any error fails the requesting turn (compose_codex_engram_instructions
:21-24), and a permanent failure is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a transient one, so
every retry re-runs the same failing request. The `initialize` response that
could carry capabilities is discarded at src/codex.rs:367-381.

FAILURE SCENARIO: a user on a Codex build without `config/read` - or one whose
reply is not shaped {"config": {...}} - CAN NEVER START A NEW THREAD IN ANY
ENGRAM-ENABLED PROJECT. The only escape is disabling Engram for the project
entirely. Nothing tells them why.

FIX DIRECTION: separate permanent from transient failures. On a
method-unsupported or malformed-shape response, either start the thread with the
bootstrap appended to no base, or start it with no bootstrap, and record a
visible notice; alternatively gate the whole path on a capability observed
during `initialize`.

NOT A REGRESSION IN SHIPPED CODE: this is in the unmerged bootstrap changeset
and must be resolved before it lands.
